name: describe_tables
description: List the tables in the spend database and their columns. Call this first to learn what data is available before writing SQL.

name: run_query
description: Run one read-only SQL SELECT query (Amazon Athena / Trino SQL) against the spend database and return up to 200 rows. Tables: department_spend (invoices per department), budgets (quarterly budget per department, fiscal_quarter like '2026-Q3'), aws_cost_export (daily AWS costs per account and service). Aggregate in SQL instead of fetching raw rows.

sql.description: A single SELECT query, without a trailing semicolon.

name: create_pdf_report
description: Create a PDF report, save it to S3 and return a download link valid for 60 minutes. Use only when the user asks for a report.

content.description: Report body in simple markdown: '# ' or '## ' headings, '- ' bullet points, '|' table rows, plain text paragraphs.
